decision.title: ELV1S: 30 #1 Hits
tracklist: (Now and Then There's) A Fool Such as I
A Little Less Conversation (JXL Radio Edit Remix)

rationale: Discography populator: full tracklist (31 tracks) per https://www.discogs.com/release/377113-Elvis-Presley-ELV1S-30-1-Hits, https://www.elvispresleyshop.com/elv1s-30-1-hits-cd-elvis-presley-greatest-hits/?setCurrencyId=5. 2002 RCA compilation (07863 68079-2): exactly 30 chart-topping singles in chronological order (1956-1977), followed by the bonus track 'A Little Less Conversation (JXL Radio Edit Remix)' as track 31 on CD. Confirmed across Discogs US CD, the official Elvis Presley Shop listing and Alibris. The DVD-Audio edition leads with the JXL remix as track 01 plus bonus A:B-test mixes and outtakes, but the standard CD/LP is 30+1 as recorded above.
